description: This file contains utility functions and classes for converting platform-specific file paths to URIs, including handling Cygwin paths and managing a subprocess for cygpath conversions.

classes.name: _CygPath
classes.description: Manages a long-running 'cygpath' process for converting Cygwin paths to Windows paths, with thread safety considerations.

methods.name: abspath_to_uri
methods.description: Converts a platform-specific absolute path to a file URI.

methods.name: cygpath
methods.description: Converts an absolute Cygwin path to an absolute Windows path.
